implementation: environment.rs renders service-reported interpreter/ABI, lock, missing/version-mismatched packages, requirement drift, pip-check output, setup state, diagnostics, and safe next steps without inferring readiness from a directory.

export.rs renders the source run, destination, checkpoint step, verified file/package counts, environment snapshot provenance, overwrite backup path, omitted external resources, and service diagnostics.

storage.rs renders service-measured storage categories, de-duplication and scan limits, retention/state protections, fixed cleanup plan targets/reasons/estimated reclaim, checkpoint recovery loss, and apply/partial-result state. These renderers do not mutate state or derive cleanup targets.

Coordinator registered the modules and wired them into the interactive workbench. Environment reports, export reports, storage reports, clean plans, and clean results now use these renderers; clean apply still submits only the service-issued plan ID.

CLI-13 environment setup now has actual workbench PTY coverage using the existing offline wheelhouse fixture; it exercises first-time venv creation, report rendering, session interpreter selection, and post-setup reuse without network access.

Workbench PTY acceptance now exercises a real trained-run export to a new destination and a second attempt against that existing destination; the conflict is rendered to the user and a pre-existing user file remains unchanged.
